title: Meet My Family & my/his/her

scenes.t: This is my father and this is my mother.
I have a brother and a sister.
My grandfather and my grandmother live with us.
My uncle and my aunt visit us. I love to play with my cousin.
We use 'my' for me, 'his' for a boy or man, and 'her' for a girl or woman.
Amira has a kite. Her kite is flying high. Nader has a book. His book is new.

activities.title: Memory Game
activities.prompt: Match the person with the right word.

why.his: For a boy or a man.
why.her: For a girl or a woman.

items.q: Amira has a kite. ___ kite is flying high.
I have a balloon. ___ balloon is yellow.
Nader has a book. ___ book is new.
This is Laila. ___ dress is pink.
Dina has a cat. ___ cat is cute.

source: English – Primary 3 – Term 1 (Ministry of Education) pp. 28–31
